failure_reason: Akamai Bot Manager IP-level block hit after ~10 successful curl_cffi requests (matches prior Home-Decor pass notes for this host). The main-site Clearance PLP, one of its category children, and the separate Crate & Kids Clearance PLP were opened and verified with exact counts before the block. Remaining category-scoped Clearance children were discovered via the site's own PLP sitemap under an identical naming convention but could not be opened for count verification before the block hit, so they carry qty:null and a MANUAL REVIEW flag rather than a fabricated number.
notes: Access: robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow; used curl_cffi TLS impersonation per prior pass notes. Sale vs. Clearance test applied per brief §3: the site's OWN /sale/ hub page renders a visual-nav carousel where a distinct tile (image asset literally named '...VisualNav_Clearance', copy 'Shop Now') links to /sale/new-clearance/1, separate from the generic '/sale/' promotional tiles (e.g. the 'ShipsFree' tile) - this is the site's own taxonomy marking this specific URL as its Clearance destination, not a generic percent-off campaign. Opening /sale/new-clearance/1 confirmed: h1 'Shop All Clearance', data-num-results/totalCount=542. The <title> tag on that page reads 'Up to 60% off Summer Clearance 2026: Exclusive Deals & Limited Time Sale' - seasonal marketing copy in the title only; the h1, on-page label, and nav placement all use 'Clearance' consistently, so this was recorded as Clearance (not excluded as a temporary Sale), per the brief's instruction to trust the site's taxonomy signal over title-tag wording. /sale/clearance-furniture/1 opened and confirmed as a genuine child (h1 'Furniture Clearance Sale', count 101) - same /sale/clearance-* URL family as the unopened children below, giving strong confidence they are genuine too, but their exact counts are unverified. /kids/clearance-kids/ opened and confirmed as a separate, non-overlapping Crate & Kids outlet listing (h1 'Up to 60% off Kids Clearance & Outlet', title 'Clearance Baby, Toddler & Kids Furniture and Home Decor Outlet | Crate & Kids', count 466) - recorded as a sibling row, not a subset of the main-site 542, matching the department-split pattern used for Bestsellers/Kids Best Sellers. Unopened kids-department clearance sub-pages found in the sitemap (kids/clearance-kids-toys, -accessories, -storage, -textiles, -baby-bedding, -kids-bedding, -kids-furniture, -baby-gear, -kids-lighting, -back-to-school-clearance, and /kids/all-kids-clearance/1 which may simply be an alias of the verified /kids/clearance-kids/ hub) were NOT added as rows - too many to responsibly flag without opening at least one to confirm they are distinct listings rather than aliases/filters of the 466 hub; flagged here for a follow-up pass. /kids/kids-final-sale/1 was seen in the sitemap ('final sale' is a brief-listed clearance term) but not opened - also left for follow-up rather than guessed.
